IHC - CD 1a

IHC MARKER(S) RESULT
CD1a Highlight dendritic cells, No definite lesional cells identified 

Comment : All external controls show appropriate reactivity.

IHC NO 346/2024
SPECIMEN Block from Lymph node for IHC markers.
CLINICAL HISTORY To rule out Langerhan’s cell histiocytosis.
GROSS Received 1 formalin fixed paraffin embedded block labelled as 2774/24

CD1a (Clone : EP 10) : CD1a is useful in the diagnosis of Langerhans cell histiocytosis and in the differential diagnosis of histiocytic lesions. CD1a is expressed on Langerhans precursors (Indeterminate cells), Langerhans cells & Thymic cortical T cells. The staining pattern is membranous. The neoplastic Langerhans cells acquire a round morphology as compared to dendritic morphology of reactive Langerhans cells.

NOTE

  1. Type of specimen Fixation & processing - Formalin fixed paraffin embedded tissue.
  2. Detection system used is Polymer HRP
  3. The impression is based on the material submitted and is not a complete surgical pathology report.
  4. False negative IHC results due to inadequate fixation of the material sent for evaluation cannot be excluded.

FIXATION REQUIREMENTS

  • The volume of formalin fixative should be atleast 10 times the volume of the specimen.
  • Decalcification solutions with strong acids should not be used.
  • Specimens should be immersed in fixative within 1 hour of the biopsy/resection procedure (time of removal & time of immersion to be mentioned).
  • In all resection (large) specimens, the tumour must be bisected prior to immersion in fixative.
